fabs.definition: Fabs the company operates in the location, out of "one 150mm wafer fab, six 200mm wafer fabs, nine 300mm wafer fabs, and five advanced backend fabs". The 20-F spells these counts out in words. Its fab locations (e.g. "Hsinchu Science Park") may be drawn wider than the employee table's rows of the same name: the fab sentence places no fab in Taoyuan or Miaoli, yet the employee table shows staff there, so fab and employee counts on one row need not cover the same area.

notes: All figures are from the 2024 Form 20-F on sec.gov (TSMC's own sites block scripted fetches). Employees: Item 6.D table of full-time employees by location, Dec 31, 2024; the six Taiwan locations are recorded as regions (countries ["TW"]) because the table has no Taiwan total, and none was summed. North America and Europe are the table's own groupings (no country list). Fabs: the 20-F gives fab counts in words ("nine of our fabs are located in the Hsinchu Science Park, two fabs are located in the Central Taiwan Science Park, five fabs are located in the Southern Taiwan Science Park, two fabs are located in the United States, one fab is located in Shanghai, one fab is located in Nanjing, and one fab is located in Japan"); quotes carry a bracketed [nine = 9] style annotation. These counts include advanced backend fabs. The fab sentence's science-park areas may not match the employee table's rows of the same name (it puts no fab in Taoyuan City or Miaoli County, where the table shows 2,817 and 3,055 employees), so a row's fab count and employee count may not describe exactly the same area. Shanghai and Nanjing (one fab each) are shown as sites, not summed into a China fab count. No U.S. state rows: the U.S. fabs are one in Washington State (Fab 11) and one in Arizona (Fab 21), shown as sites with state codes; no per-state employee or investment figures are published in the 20-F. Fab 22 (Kaohsiung) and Fab 24 (Dresden) were not yet operating. Site descriptions take year/wafer size/technology from the 20-F fab table (as of Feb 28, 2025; technology as of 2024 year-end).
